title: I'm running an AI game jam! Every game is multiplayer and winner takes $1000 ($2000 prize pool)
author: onedayiwaswalkingand
selftext:
Hey all! I'm the dev behind Partytime and I'm hosting my first game jam!  It runs from May 29 to June 8. Voting ends on June 15. First place will get $1000!

🔗 [https://itch.io/jam/partytime-game-jam-1](https://itch.io/jam/partytime-game-jam-1)

**What makes building on Partytime super interesting:**

* Every game is multiplayer out of the box.
* You can prompt the agent to generate AND rig 3D assets
* SerpAPI baked in: build games that query real data at runtime (you can make “Guess the price” with real Amazon listings!)



**💰 Prizes ($2,000 total)**

🥇 1st — $1,000 + featured in-app

🥈 2nd — $500 + featured

🥉 3rd — $200 + featured

🏅 4th–6th — $100 each



Looking to test drive the engine with people who actually like to build. Would love to see what this community makes 🙏

comments.author: Felfedezni
comments.body: How do these work? Are we expected to build paying for our tokens?

replies.author: onedayiwaswalkingand
replies.body: You join the discord and then build on Partytime. No paying for any tokens! Basically we're footing the bill for tokens and a bunch of tools like 3D modelling, rigging and real time search APIs!

comments.author: Mahazael
comments.body: Hey I have a question: I see it's an android app? So we build the game from the phone?

replies.author: onedayiwaswalkingand
replies.body: Yeah right now you can build games from either the iOS or Android client.

replies.author: Mahazael
replies.body:
Yeah but what I mean is: there is a built-in way to use it from PC? I find pretty slow and inconvenient type a long prompt from the phone 😅

Or maybe I can try and emulator if it's allowed

replies.author: onedayiwaswalkingand
replies.body: Not yet. But we are building one! Would you mind adding me on Discord and I can let you into the alpha test! Sounds like you would love it
